title: DECONSTRUCTING BIAS: A MULTIFACETED FRAME WORK FOR DIAGNOSING CULTURAL AND COMPOSI TIONAL INEQUITIES IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE GENERATIVE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models using the Component Inclusion Score (CIS) to quantify differences in representational fidelity, compositional fragility, and contextual misalignment between Western and non-Western (marginalized) cultural prompts involving monuments, vehicles, flags, clothing, and food.
